products.title: ARETH HK Gen3 AEG Spring Magazine

The ARETH HK416 AEG Spring Magazine is a nylon spring-powered magazine designed for smooth, reliable feeding, realistic HK Gen3 styling and dependable performance from different shooting angles.

Why ARETH HK416 AEG Spring Magazine

  • Supports up to 50 RPS.

products.title: Colt M733 Commando AEG Gel Blaster | E&C Ultra Line
products.body_html:
E&C Colt M733 Gel Blaster is a faithful replica of the Colt Model 733 Commando carbine, which was favored by special forces in the 1980s and 1990s. Inside, it features an upgraded E&C ultra line metal gearbox. Whether you’re a fan of classic AR-style collectibles or love playing out on the field, this Colt M733 gel blaster is a great choice.

Background on the Colt M733

The Colt Model 733 Commando was introduced by Colt during the 1980s and 1990s to meet the demand for a shorter, lighter carbine suited to close-range operations. Based on the M16/AR-15 system, it featured a shorter barrel and more compact overall length while retaining the 5.56×45mm cartridge and the familiar AR direct-line operating layout. Compared with submachine guns that typically used 9mm pistol ammunition, the M733 offered greater power and rifle-caliber performance, while still being much shorter and more CQB-friendly than a standard M16. As a result, the Colt M733 became popular with police and special forces users, including Delta Force and USMC Force Recon. The M733 also gained recognition through its appearances in films, most famously Black Hawk Down and Heat. Even today, many collectors and players still appreciate this retro AR-style carbine for its compact profile, old-school tactical look, and strong connection to classic special operations history.

External Features

  • It was developed in cooperation between E&C and CyberGun under official Colt license
  • It features clean, engraved markings for an authentic tactical appearance
  • It recreates the look of the Colt Model 733 Commando, including the birdcage flash hider, triangular front sight, classic round handguard, fixed carry handle upper receiver, 11.5 inch barrel, classic CAR style retractable stock and M16A2 style receiver.
  • It recreates the short 11.5-inch outer barrel, making it suitable for close range play.

Internal Features

  • Reinforced CNC Gearbox – Durable steer gears, Full steel teeth piston, CNC copper high-durability cylinder head, CNC 7075 alluminum alloy piston head, stainless steel cylinder, CNC 7075 aluminum alloy / Copper nozzle, CNC aluminum alloy bearing shaft motor, Programmable electronic trigger unit mosfet
  • Mosfet: Programmable Eshooter v2 basic mosfet (no app control)
  • Front-wired setup with the battery compartment inside the handguard.

Specifications

  • Gel Blaster Manufacturer: E&C
  • Model: Colt M733
  • SKU: EC-326
  • Colour: Black
  • Power System: Electric
  • External Material: Full metal/alloy with polymer handguard, pistol grip and buttstock
  • Internal Material: Reinforced CNC gearbox with upgraded metal internal parts
  • Fire Modes: Safe / Semi / Full Auto
  • Muzzle Speed: 360 FPS
  • Rate of Fire: 18 RPS
  • Magazine Capacity: 200 rounds
  • Magazine Priming: Yes
  • Effective Firing Distance: about 30-40 m
  • Battery Plug Type: Deans
  • Product Weight: 2.3 kg

  • Package Dimensions: 75 × 25 × 9 cm

What's in the Box

Safety Notes

  • Remove the battery when the gel blaster is not in use.
  • Unplug the battery once fully charged.
  • Drain excess water from your gel balls before loading them into the magazine. Do not use gel balls that are too wet.
  • Never point the muzzle at people nearby. Always wear safety glasses when shooting.
  • Gel balls are not edible.
  • There is a small grub screw on the muzzle that helps secure it in place. Remove this small screw before unscrewing the muzzle, otherwise the outer barrel may be damaged.
To get your gel blaster up and running, don’t forget to add batteries and charger to your order!

products.body_html:
The Evolution Gear AMG 1-10x24mm FFP scope is a premium LPVO optic kit built for demanding gel blaster builds that need both realistic appearance and versatile functionality. It's a complete setup with the Evolution Gear AMG 1-10x24mm FFP scope on its AUS mount, an ACRO piggyback mount and an ACRO P-2 red dot, ready to fit your build straight out of the box. If you're building a KS-1 gel blaster, this scope and red dot combo is worth a serious look.

Description

  • With its 1-10x magnification range, first focal plane reticle, and included 34mm AUS-style mount with piggyback red dot, this setup is built to cover everything from close-range target transitions to mid-range engagements.
  • This replica scope delivers excellent look and feel — build, proportions, and weight closely match the real thing. Turrets are tactile with crisp clicks. Glass is clear with great light transmission, and the FFP reticle scales with magnification. Making a good copy of the AMG 1-10x24 FFP isn't easy. Fitting a 1-10x zoom and an FFP reticle (the reticle scales with magnification) into a compact and lightweight scope body is hard to pull off, and it's a challenge even for the original. That is why this quality replica doesn't come cheap. It's ideal for premium display builds, clone-inspired setups, and users wanting a complete LPVO package.

Specifications

  • SKU: EVG-1089C
  • Colour: Black / Cerakoted TAN
  • Magnification: 1-10x
  • Focal Plane: FFP
  • Objective Lens Diameter: 24 mm
  • Objective Outer Diameter: 34 mm

  • Weight (without mount): 533 g

What's in the Box

  • Lens cloth
  • Tools
  • 2*CR2032 batteries

Background on the Original Optic

The AMG 1-10x24 FFP was originally a custom build commissioned by the British Ministry of Defence for a UK special forces unit. The brief was a 1-10x scope optimised for CQB but still accurate at long range, packed into an unusually short body with a short eye relief. After Vortex delivered the MoD contract, a slightly refined civilian version was released to the market. The scope went on to be issued as the official optic suite on the British Ministry of Defence's KS-1 (L403A1) rifle system, compact enough to run on carbines fully kitted with thermal attachments, lasers, red dots and backup irons.

Note

To adjust the brightness, pull the illumination dial outward to unlock, rotate to the desired setting, and push it back in to lock.

products.body_html:
Eshooter V2 SE Mosfet, a brand new designed electronic trigger unit for your replica. With Eshooter App control and reliable mechnical trigger switch, it can perfectly avoid complicated testing and know your AEG details through your phone. Try with affordable price, Kestrel V2 SE won't let you regret.

Eshooter V2 SE Mosfet is a budget-friendly Bluetooth MOSFET that delivers essential performance and smart control.

Key Features of the Eshooter Kestrel Bluetooth Mosfet/ ETU System

•Pre-Cocking Adjustment

Fine-tune pre-cocking mode with 100 levels of precision, ensuring optimal performance in all firing modes and improving trigger response.

•Brushless Motor Support

Fully compatible with high-speed, high-torque, and brushless motors for enhanced power and reliability.

•Selector Modes

Customize firing modes, including SAFE, SEMI, BINARY, Burst, AUTO, and Sniper, for a tailored shooting experience that suits your tactical needs. (AUG Mode is not available)

•Personalized Settings

Save up to 5 custom settings and rename your device for a truly personalized experience. Switch profiles effortlessly via the app.

•ROF Control (Rate of Fire)

Adjust the rate of fire to your preference, even when using high-voltage batteries, for consistent and controlled performance.

•Sensor Calibration

Built-in calibration ensures precise alignment with your gearbox for optimal performance and accuracy.

•Battery Protection

Prevents over-discharge of LiPo/LiFe batteries by monitoring voltage levels. The app provides low-battery warnings to ensure your equipment stays powered.

•Active Brake

Prevents double shots by ensuring the piston stops in the forward position, extending the life of internal components and improving reliability.

•Cycle Detection

Detects gear cycle completion with a rack sensor. Supports DSG, HSG, and standard gear configurations for versatility.

•Firmware Updates

Keep your system up to date with free OTA (Over-The-Air) updates via the Eshooter App.

•Smart Fuse Protection

Built-in intelligent fuse system protects the motor, battery, and controller from overheating, overloading, and short circuits.

•Sleep Mode

Automatically enters sleep mode after one hour of inactivity to conserve battery power. Simply reconnect the battery to reactivate. Perfect for long MILSIM games.

•Locked Rotor Protection

Safeguards your gearbox from damage when gears or motors encounter issues.

•Sniper Delay Mode

Adds realistic shot delays of 0.5s, 1s, 2s, or 3s for precision shooting and a more immersive experience.

products.title: SOLINK Digital Programming Board For Solink V5 Motor
products.body_html:
SOLINK Digital Programming Board allows precise speed adjustments, offering customizable settings for enhanced performance and control in your gel blaster.

SOLINK Digital Programming Board Setup Guideline:

  • Motor speed can be adjusted between 10k-46k rpm with 1k rpm increments with this digital programming card (Default value: 46k rpm ,11.1v)Please Note: Digital programming board  only work with V5 Brushless motor (Click here to see more), not workable for our other models either other brands motor.

• The starting torque of the motor can be adjusted by current change. (Default value:60%)

  • It can also be used to check the health of the battery, and automatically detects the battery voltage and percentage of remaining charge after the battery is linked

Button Description:

• M Button: Short press to select the item to be set, long press to quickly reconnect when disconnected from the motor.

• –  Button: Short press to decrease the value of the selected item, long press to quickly decrease the value of the selected item.

• + Button: Short press to increase the value of the selected item, long press to quickly increase the value of the selected item.

• S Button: Long press to save the settings to the motor.

Attention:

1) Some malfunctions, poor contact, or unexpected situations may cause the motor to rotate unexpectedly. Therefore, the motor must be securely fixed before using this product.

2) The motor must be reliably connected to the cable of the board before the board can be powered on, otherwise it may cause accidental rotation of the motor.

3) The battery voltage used to power the programming board must be higher than 7.4V, otherwise it may cause the motor to rotate unexpectedly.

4) After the settings are saved, the programming board will self-disconnect and disconnect from the motor. If you want to reset it, you must power it on again or press and hold the M button to reconnect.

5) While in the setting menu, do not disconnect the motor wires, otherwise it may cause the motor to rotate unexpectedly.

6) If the maximum current rating of the ETU is lower than the defined starting current of the motor,we are NOT responsible for the damage it might caused.

7) Please confirm the correct polarity before installation. Do not reverse the positive and negative connections. Damage caused by incorrect polarity is not covered under warranty.

products.title: AEG Gearbox Retuning & Optimization Service
products.body_html:
CyberTrigger’s expert service team provides professional gearbox retuning and optimization to ensure your blaster performs smoothly, reliably, and efficiently from day one. Our service includes a full gearbox disassembly, precision adjustment, and reassembly to improve durability, FPS consistency, and overall performance.

Key enhancements include gear reshimming, airseal optimization, AoE correction, gearbox strengthening, proper motor alignment, and upgraded lubrication — all designed to extend lifespan and deliver stable, consistent performance.

All retuned gearboxes are handled by experienced technicians and include an extended 3-month warranty for added peace of mind.

Please note: This service is only available for brand new blasters.

CyberTrigger’s expert service team provides professional gearbox retuning and optimization, ensuring your blaster functions smoothly, reliably, and efficiently straight out of the box. Many stock blasters are always not in the best condition due to quality control issues or factory assembly inconsistencies, resulting in suboptimal performance, inefficient or premature wear.

Our retuning service involves a full disassembly and reassembly of your gearbox with precision adjustments, enhancing durability, FPS consistency, and overall performance.

Service Includes:

✔ Gear Reshimming – Ensures perfect meshing between gear teeth, producing a crisp operation sound and significantly increasing gear longevity.

✔ Bushing & Bearing Locking – Securely fastens bushings and bearings using high-strength retaining compounds, preventing movement and ensuring stable gear meshing.

✔ Gearbox Radiusing – Strengthens the gearbox shell, dramatically reducing the risk of cracks and structural failures.

✔ Sorbothane Cylinder Head Padding – Adds a high-quality Sorbothane pad to the back of the cylinder head to absorb piston impact and reduce gearbox stress.

✔ Angle of Engagement Correction – Optimizes piston engagement via Sorbothane padding, increasing piston lifespan and reducing wear.

✔ Gear Screw Locking – Applies Loctite to sector gear and pinion gear screws to prevent loosening during operation.

✔ Pinion-to-Bevel Alignment – Fine-tunes the alignment between the pinion gear and bevel gear, preventing stripping or gear damage.

✔ Motor Base Plate Locking – Secures the motor base plate to prevent unwanted adjustments, avoiding catastrophic damage to the pinion and bevel gears.

✔ Regreasing of Gears & Airseal Components – Improves compression, enhancing FPS stability and consistency.

✔ Piston O-Ring Upgrade – Replaces the stock O-ring with a high-quality variant, ensuring better compression, range, and FPS consistency.

Service Benefits:

CyberTrigger’s retuning process ensures that every aspect of your blaster’s gearbox is professionally optimized for performance, durability, and reliability.

All services are performed by expert technicians, and the retuned gearbox comes with a extended 3-month warranty, providing you with peace of mind and a superior gaming experience.

products.body_html:
The Eshooter Kestrel Mosfet is a Bluetooth-enabled electronic upgrade for Gel Blaster V2 gearboxes. It provides programmable features, improved efficiency, and greater control over your blaster’s performance.

To ensure proper installation and maintain warranty coverage, we strongly recommend having the MOSFET installed by our qualified technicians. Any damage resulting from unauthorized installation will void the warranty.

Key Features of the Eshooter Kestrel Bluetooth Mosfet/ ETU System

•Pre-Cocking Adjustment

Fine-tune pre-cocking mode with 100 levels of precision, ensuring optimal performance in all firing modes and improving trigger response.

•Brushless Motor Support

Fully compatible with high-speed, high-torque, and brushless motors for enhanced power and reliability.

•Trigger Sensitivity Adjustment

Five sensors detect trigger movement, allowing precise adjustments without disassembly. Customize sensitivity easily via the wireless Eshooter App.

•Selector Modes

Customize firing modes, including SAFE, SEMI, BINARY, Burst, AUG, AUTO, and Sniper, for a tailored shooting experience that suits your tactical needs.

•Magazine Shot Counter

Simulate realistic magazine functionality with adjustable round counts from 30 to 100, adding immersion to your gameplay.

•Personalized Settings

Save up to 5 custom settings and rename your device for a truly personalized experience. Switch profiles effortlessly via the app.

•ROF Control (Rate of Fire)

Adjust the rate of fire to your preference, even when using high-voltage batteries, for consistent and controlled performance.

•Sensor Calibration

Built-in calibration ensures precise alignment with your gearbox for optimal performance and accuracy.

•Battery Protection

Prevents over-discharge of LiPo/LiFe batteries by monitoring voltage levels. The app provides low-battery warnings to ensure your equipment stays powered.

•Active Brake

Prevents double shots by ensuring the piston stops in the forward position, extending the life of internal components and improving reliability.

•Cycle Detection

Detects gear cycle completion with a rack sensor. Supports DSG, HSG, and standard gear configurations for versatility.

•Firmware Updates

Keep your system up to date with free OTA (Over-The-Air) updates via the Eshooter App.

•Smart Fuse Protection

Built-in intelligent fuse system protects the motor, battery, and controller from overheating, overloading, and short circuits.

•Sleep Mode

Automatically enters sleep mode after one hour of inactivity to conserve battery power. Simply reconnect the battery to reactivate. Perfect for long MILSIM games.

•Advanced MOSFET

Directly channels battery power to the motor, boosting rate of fire (ROF) and trigger response for an edge in every skirmish.

•Locked Rotor Protection

Safeguards your gearbox from damage when gears or motors encounter issues.

•Sniper Delay Mode

Adds realistic shot delays of 0.5s, 1s, 2s, or 3s for precision shooting and a more immersive experience.
